notes.title: NEW KIT ADDED ! MORE MUSIC TRACKS TOO!
notes.content:
We're hearing great ideas from everyone and moving on all fronts.

More KITS?  Sure!
More music?  You betcha!

There are so many amazing artists out there.  MORE was always the plan!

Things are flowing along.  We're hard at work arranging localization so KITS can be enjoyed by as many people as possible.  We're also... well, let's leave something for the Community posts, shall we?

Enjoy!

notes.title: Update for 23.04.03.0
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
There were a few things that were all primed and ready, but then a certain someone (me) forgot to make them the default build!  Brilliant.

Should be a quick download.

Changes:
[x] SWAP pan and separate --> shift/ctrl-MMB to separate, MMB to pan
[x] BUG - organize z axis was bunched up --> distributed better vertically
[x] "Organize" on O key --> "find detached" on F key
[x] BUG --> challenge award for expert is now awarded
[x] BUG --> initial title screen persists volume setting and thus first play for Steam deck
[x] BUG --> V8 gaskets are now 2-sided for grabbing
[x] BUG --> candle/torch flames rotate towards view in Viking Cottage
[x] BUG --> camera remembered when going from build --> final view --> build
[x] default resolution now defaults to desktop resolution
[x] Exit phrase "Always good times" --> "Always a good time"
